Name: Complex Cooking - Cooking Skill and Kitchen Overhaul
Author: vcsama
Description:
[size=6][b]Complex Cooking[/b][/size]

Hands-on cooking inspired by Overcooked. Prepare 80 vanilla dishes through chopping, mixing, heating, baking, cooling, and assembly, with illustrated recipes, a Cooking skill, and professions.

Supports English and Simplified Chinese. Other languages use English.

[size=5][b]Cooking and settings[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Uses vanilla ingredients and quantities. No extra water or mandatory seasoning.[/*]
[*]Click a learned recipe to view its illustrated guide.[/*]
[*]Play timing minigames or turn them off for automatic preparation and heating. You still handle ingredients, cookware, and plating.[/*]
[*]Level Cooking from 0 to 10 and choose professions at levels 5 and 10 for ingredient refunds, extra servings, sale value, or restorative effects.[/*]
[*]Manual quality depends on ingredients and performance. Automatic quality uses the cook's level and ingredients, retaining XP and first-cook rewards without perfect-cooking bonuses.[/*]
[/list]
Open [b]GMCM → Complex Cooking[/b] for the mod toggle, minigames, controls, processing times, layouts, and integration settings. Automatic preparation defaults to 3 seconds and heating to 6 seconds; both are adjustable from 1–60 seconds. Mixing, baking, and cooling keep their existing times.

The mod toggle is available on the title screen and applies when loading a save. Disabling restores menu cooking while preserving your items, progress, and layouts.

[size=5][b]Kitchens and cookware[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Farmhouse:[/b] the first upgrade unlocks the kitchen; the second adds more workstations.[/*]
[*][b]Island Farmhouse:[/b] repair the house to use its kitchen. The relocated fridge keeps its inventory.[/*]
[*][b]Custom layouts:[/b] move stations, add counters, choose two- or three-tile racks, and adjust their direction through GMCM or the cooking menu's Kitchen Layout button. Layouts are saved separately for each house.[/*]
[/list]
Carry cookware with its contents and move it between compatible stations. Plates are unlimited and need no washing. Automatic heating pauses off the burner and resumes when returned.

To empty a container, use the inventory trash can: recover one original ingredient with its quality, discard the rest, and keep the container.

[size=5][b]Optional compatibility[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Farmer's Store — 1.0.3[/b][/size]

Choose the kitchen system for each building in [b]GMCM → Complex Cooking → Current building kitchen[/b]. Farmer's Store cooking is the default. Complex Cooking mode keeps its built-in farmhouse kitchen and supports purchased stations in other indoor buildings.

[list]
[*]Buy stations from [b]Focus on shelves for twenty years[/b] and cookware from [b]Open a treasure store[/b]. Unlock suppliers and the food-sales license normally.[/*]
[*]Counters cost [b]100g[/b]; other Complex Cooking stations and cookware cost [b]2,000g[/b] each.[/*]
[*]Empty stoves accept frying pans, deep pots, or steamers. Counters join together and each holds one item. Purchased racks support two or three tiles and adjustable directions.[/*]
[*]Empty stations before removing them with a pickaxe. Empty cookware returns with its stove; return a mixer's bowl before removing the mixer.[/*]
[/list]
Our plated dishes can be served directly. Default menu prices include quality and profession bonuses; manual prices take priority. Tables, orders, delivery, and accounting remain with Farmer's Store.

Complex Cooking mode hides redundant equipment and removes the dirty-plate workflow. Farmer's Store mode keeps its original workflow. Empty food and ingredients before switching systems; purchased equipment is retained.

[size=4][b]Better Crafting — 2.18.0[/b][/size]

Enable [b]ReplaceCooking[/b] to use its cooking browser. Supported recipes open our guides and use our workstations; other recipes follow Better Crafting's normal rules. Its favorites and our pinned guides are separate.

[size=4][b]Restauranteer — original 1.1.1[/b][/size]

Cook orders in its default Saloon kitchen, with supplied ingredients in the fridge and seven storage spaces along the bar. Restauranteer handles orders and rewards. Enable its default Saloon map patch and meet its event requirement.

[size=4][b]Retextures, layouts, and added recipes[/b][/size]

Counters follow the loaded farmhouse textures. Layouts using vanilla kitchen tiles can be detected automatically or adjusted in the layout editor. Custom Saloon and Island Farmhouse maps need separate support.

Added or altered recipes keep their current ingredients, unlocks, and crafting rules. They do not automatically gain our minigames or manual Cooking XP.

[size=5][b]Controls[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Left-click:[/b] pick up, place, add ingredients, plate food, or make a minigame attempt.[/*]
[*][b]Cooking key (default Q):[/b] start processing; pause or resume a minigame. Change it in GMCM.[/*]
[*][b]Esc:[/b] leave a minigame and keep progress.[/*]
[*][b]Alt + left-click a recipe:[/b] pin or unpin its guide. Scroll over pinned guides to browse rows.[/*]
[*][b]Held plate rack:[/b] cooking key changes size; right-click changes direction. Pick up a placed rack before adjusting it.[/*]
[*][b]Placed fridge:[/b] right-click to access ingredients. Hover over containers to inspect their contents.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Qi Seasoning:[/b] hold it and click a finished dish on a counter or in cookware. One seasoning raises one normal or silver serving to gold.

[b]Coffee Maker:[/b] hold three Coffees and click the machine to make one ordinary Triple Shot Espresso. This grants no Cooking XP and leaves its daily Coffee untouched.

[size=5][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]

Use matching Complex Cooking and SpaceCore versions, with the required dependencies on every player's setup. The host controls layouts and shared settings; players choose their own minigame preference and cooking key. Pinned guides are shared, and each manual workstation allows one player at a time.

The world clock pauses when everyone is in minigames or pausable menus. Automatic work alone does not pause it. Same-device split screen is unsupported.

[size=5][b]Requirements and installation[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley [b]1.6.15[/b]; SMAPI tested with [b]4.5.2[/b].[/*]
[*]Required: [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore 1.28.4+[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM 1.16.0+[/url].[/*]
[/list]
Install the dependencies, extract [b]ComplexCooking[/b] into the game's [b]Mods[/b] folder, and launch through SMAPI. For updates, close the game, back up your save, and replace the old folder. Keep [b]config.json[/b] to retain settings.

Developed on Windows; other operating systems are unverified.

[size=5][b]Credits[/b][/size]

Thanks to ConcernedApe, the SMAPI, SpaceCore, and GMCM developers, my boyfriend Tzd for his inspiration and company, and everyone providing feedback and testing.

An independent fan project with no official Overcooked affiliation. AI tools assisted with code and some artwork.


[size=6][b]简体中文说明[/b][/size]

来做铱星菜！复杂料理参考《胡闹厨房》的动手做菜体验，为原版 80 道菜加入切配、搅拌、加热、烘焙、冷却和组合流程，以及菜谱示意图、厨艺技能和职业。

支持简体中文和英文，其他语言使用英文。

[size=5][b]做饭与设置[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]沿用原版材料和数量，无需额外加水或强制添加调料。[/*]
[*]点击已学习的菜谱查看制作流程。[/*]
[*]小游戏可以开启或关闭；关闭后自动切配和加热，仍需投料、搬运厨具与装盘。[/*]
[*]厨艺从 0 级升至 10 级，在 5 级和 10 级选择职业，获得原料返还、额外产出、售价或食用恢复加成。[/*]
[*]手动品质受原料和操作表现影响；自动品质按制作者厨艺与原料计算，保留经验和首次奖励，不获得完美操作加成。[/*]
[/list]
在 [b]GMCM → Complex Cooking／复杂料理[/b] 中调整总开关、小游戏、按键、加工时长、布局和兼容设置。自动切配默认 3 秒，加热默认 6 秒，均可设为 1～60 秒；搅拌、烘焙和冷却保留原时长。

总开关在标题界面修改，下次载入生效。关闭后恢复菜单做菜，保留物品、进度和布局。

[size=5][b]厨房与厨具[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]农舍：[/b]首次升级解锁厨房，第二次升级增加工位。[/*]
[*][b]姜岛农舍：[/b]修复后使用厨房，移位冰箱保留库存。[/*]
[*][b]自定义布局：[/b]从 GMCM 或做菜菜单的“厨房布局”进入，移动工位、添加台面、选择两格或三格盘架并调整方向。布局按房屋分别保存。[/*]
[/list]
厨具可连同内容物搬运，在兼容工位间移动。空盘无限取用，无需清洗。自动加热离开炉位时暂停，放回后继续。

通过物品栏垃圾桶清空容器时，可取回一份原始食材并保留品质，其余内容倒掉，容器留下。

[size=5][b]可选兼容[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]农夫小店 1.0.3[/b][/size]

进入建筑，在 [b]GMCM → Complex Cooking → 当前建筑厨房[/b] 选择系统，默认使用农夫小店厨房。选择复杂料理后，农舍使用自带厨房，其他室内建筑可摆放购买的工位。

[list]
[*]在[b]专注货架二十年[/b]买工位，在[b]开店百宝店[/b]买锅具；供应商和食品经营许可按原流程解锁。[/*]
[*]置物台 [b]100g[/b]，其余复杂料理工位和锅具 [b]2000g／件[/b]。[/*]
[*]空灶台可放平底锅、深锅或蒸屉。置物台支持拼接，每格放一件物品。买来的盘架支持两格、三格及方向调整。[/*]
[*]取空内容后用镐回收设备。空锅随灶台返还，拆搅拌台前需归还搅拌碗。[/*]
[/list]
成品可直接上菜，默认菜单价计入品质和职业加成，手动标价优先。餐桌、订单、配送和记账继续由农夫小店负责。

复杂料理厨房隐藏重复设备，并取消脏盘清洗流程；农夫小店厨房保留原流程。切换系统前先取走食物和原料，已买设备保留。

[size=4][b]Better Crafting 2.18.0[/b][/size]

开启 [b]ReplaceCooking[/b] 后使用其做饭菜单。支持的菜谱打开我们的指南并在工位制作，其他菜谱沿用原规则。它的收藏与我们的流程图收藏分开保存。

[size=4][b]Restauranteer 原版 1.1.1[/b][/size]

在默认酒吧厨房制作订单，冰箱提供原料，前方吧台有七格置物位。点单与报酬由 Restauranteer 管理。需启用默认酒吧地图改动，并满足原有事件条件。

[size=4][b]美化、房型与新增菜谱[/b][/size]

台面跟随当前农舍贴图。使用原版厨房素材的布局可自动识别，也可在编辑器调整；自定义酒吧和姜岛地图需要单独适配。

新增或修改的菜谱沿用实际材料、解锁和制作规则，不会自动获得本模组的小游戏或手工厨艺经验。

[size=5][b]操作[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]左键：[/b]拿放、投料、装盘；小游戏内进行判定。[/*]
[*][b]加工键（默认 Q）：[/b]开始加工，或在小游戏内暂停／继续，可在 GMCM 改键。[/*]
[*][b]Esc：[/b]退出小游戏，保留进度。[/*]
[*][b]Alt＋左键菜谱：[/b]收藏／取消流程图；悬停后滚动滚轮翻阅。[/*]
[*][b]手持盘架：[/b]加工键切换大小，右键转向。已摆好的先收起再调整。[/*]
[*][b]已放置的冰箱：[/b]右键存取原料。悬停容器可查看内容。[/*]
[/list]
[b]齐氏调味料：[/b]手持调味料，点击台面或厨具里的成品，每份将一份普通或银星料理提升至金星。

[b]咖啡机：[/b]手持三杯咖啡点击机器，换一杯普通品质三倍浓缩咖啡，不增加厨艺经验，也不影响当天咖啡产出。

[size=5][b]多人联机[/b][/size]

所有玩家统一复杂料理和 SpaceCore 版本，并安装必装前置。房主调整布局和共享设置，每人独立选择小游戏与加工按键。流程图收藏共享，一个手动工位同时限一人操作。

所有人都在小游戏或可暂停菜单时，世界时钟暂停；自动加工本身不暂停时间。不支持同机分屏。

[size=5][b]安装要求[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]星露谷物语 [b]1.6.15[/b]，SMAPI 已使用 [b]4.5.2[/b] 验证。[/*]
[*]必装：[url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]、[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]SpaceCore 1.28.4+[/url]、[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM 1.16.0+[/url]。[/*]
[/list]
装好前置，将 [b]ComplexCooking[/b] 文件夹解压到游戏的 [b]Mods[/b] 中，通过 SMAPI 启动。更新前退出游戏并备份存档，再替换旧文件夹；保留 [b]config.json[/b] 可沿用设置。

开发平台为 Windows，其他系统尚未验证。

[size=5][b]致谢[/b][/size]

感谢 ConcernedApe、SMAPI、SpaceCore 和 GMCM 开发者，感谢男朋友 Tzd 的灵感与陪伴，以及参与反馈和测试的玩家。

本模组为独立同人项目，与《胡闹厨房》官方无关联。代码和部分美术使用了 AI 工具辅助制作。
